name: nexus_update_mod_direct_download
description:
Enable or disable direct (no-ads) downloads on your own mod [v2 - no v1 quota] [OAuth required].

Requires OAuth login (nexus_oauth_login + nexus_oauth_exchange) - this
user-context mutation is rejected under apikey-only auth even for the mod
owner. Useful for mod authors automating release pipelines.

Returns:
    JSON payload from Nexus or an error string.

enabled.description: True to enable direct downloads for this mod, false to disable.
enabled.title: Enabled

mod_uid.description: Mod UID (numeric string, e.g. from nexus_get_mod 'uid').
mod_uid.title: Mod Uid
